description: Nestled in the Andes mountains of southwestern Colombia, Huila is one of the country's most celebrated coffee-growing regions. The combination of high altitude, rich volcanic soil, and the meeting of north and south winds creates ideal conditions for producing exceptional Arabica beans with bright acidity and complex flavour profiles.
farmStory: Flor Esencia — 'Flower Essence' — is a small family farm in the hills of Huila. The farmers here practice traditional, hands-on cultivation, harvesting cherries by hand and processing them with care. The result is a coffee with real character: clean, nuanced, and deeply rooted in place.

description: Sumatra produces some of the world's most distinctive coffees, shaped by the island's volcanic terrain, humid climate, and unique processing methods. Grown under rainforest canopy by small family farmers, Sumatran beans are known for their full body, low acidity, and earthy depth — flavours as complex and layered as the landscape itself.
farmStory: Our Sumatran beans are sourced from small family farms in the highlands, where coffee has been grown for generations. The wet-hulled process — called Giling Basah — is unique to Indonesia and gives the coffee its characteristic body and intensity.
